Joel 2:1: Blow a trumpet in Zion! Proclaim on My holy mountain, and let all who inhabit the land be thrown into turmoil, because the Lord’s day is present; it is near,
Joel 2:2: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of cloud and mist. Like dawn a numerous and strong people will be poured over the mountains. Its like has never existed, nor will another follow it through the years, for generations upon generations.
Joel 2:3: Before it is consuming fire, and behind it a kindled flame. The land before its face is like a garden of delight, and behind it a desolate plain; no one will escape it.
Joel 2:4: Their appearance is like the sight of horses; like riders they will pursue.
Joel 2:5: With a sound like chariots they will leap upon mountain peaks, like the sound of a fiery flame devouring stubble, like a numerous and strong people arrayed for war.
Joel 2:6: Before it peoples will be crushed; every face is like the scorching of a pot.
Joel 2:7: Like fighters they will run, and like soldiers they will climb the walls. Each will go on his own road, and they certainly will not turn aside from their paths,
Joel 2:9: They will seize the city and run upon the walls; they will climb upon the houses and enter through windows like thieves.
Joel 2:10: Before them the earth will be thrown into turmoil and heaven shaken; the sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will sink their brightness.
Joel 2:11: The Lord will give His voice before His force, because His camp is very large, because the works of His words are strong. For the Lord’s day is great, great and very manifest; who will be sufficient for it?
2 Corinthians 4:7: But we have this treasure in clay jars, so that the surpassing power may be God’s and not from us.
2 Corinthians 4:8: We are afflicted in every way, but not confined; perplexed, but not utterly at a loss;
2 Corinthians 4:9: persecuted, but not abandoned; struck down, but not destroyed;
2 Corinthians 4:10: always carrying in the body the dying of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
2 Corinthians 4:11: For we who live are always being handed over to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal flesh.
2 Corinthians 4:12: So death is at work in us, but life in you.
Joel 4:12: Let all the nations be roused and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, because there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
Joel 4:13: Send out sickles, because the vintage is at hand! Enter and tread, because the winepress is full; the vats overflow, because their evils have multiplied.
Joel 4:15: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will sink their brightness.
Joel 4:16: The Lord will cry out from Zion and give His voice from Jerusalem; heaven and earth will shake. But the Lord will spare His people, and the Lord will strengthen the sons of Israel.
Zephaniah 1:14: For the Lord’s great day is near, near and very swift. The sound of the Lord’s day is bitter and harsh; it is appointed mighty.
Zephaniah 1:15: That day is a day of wrath, a day of affliction and constraint, a day of untimely ruin and destruction, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of cloud and mist,
Zephaniah 1:16: a day of trumpet and shouting against fortified cities and high corners.
Zephaniah 1:17: I will press people hard, and they will walk like the blind because they sinned against the Lord. He will pour out their blood like dust and their flesh like dung.
Zephaniah 1:18: Their silver and gold will certainly not rescue them on the day of the Lord’s wrath. In the fire of His jealousy all the earth will be consumed, for He will bring completion and haste upon all the earth’s inhabitants.
